Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have ambrosius and demdemeh in play.

Demdemeh
Tzimisce
Capacity: 10
Group: 4
Laibon: If any Gehenna cards are in play during your untap phase, you may move an animal retainer on Demdemeh to your ready region as an animal ally with 1 strength and 1 bleed. While that animal has more than 2 life, he or she gets +1 strength.

Ambrosius, The Ferryman (Wraith)
Ally
Giovanni
Unique wraith with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Ambrosius is immune to damage that is not aggravated. He can move a retainer from your ash heap to a ready vampire you control as an action. Put 3 Pathos counters on the retainer. Remove a Pathos counter from the retainer at the beginning of each of your minion phases. When there are no Pathos counters remaining, remove the retainer from the game.

If demdemeh gets a retainer from ambrosius and demdemeh changes the retainer to and ally. Do the pathgos counters still go away at the same pace? Is it still an retainer somehow?

Have a cold long night,
Jeroen van Oort
Dutch National Coördinator

Messages.Author: Malachy
Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> I think as Demdemeh's ability affects the retainer it becomes an ally so Ambrosius' text refferring to retainers no longer reacts with it. But IANPB
>
Correct: The Pathos counters remain, but Ambrosius is no longer removing them from the card.
The card is no longer a retainer (for matters such as Marcus Vitel's ability) and fully is an ally (for matters such as Juniper's ability).
